title: More tennis. Less paperwork.
intro: Organize a session, keep the score, and let everyone follow along.
note: This is the starter screen. Host sign-in and the session screens are coming next.
courtLabel: One court. Everyone in the game.
milestone: THE BUILD, ONE STEP AT A TIME
step1Body: Connect this interface to your existing host account.
step2Body: Build the roster and session screens from the approved design.
step3Body: Add match controls, the leaderboard, and the player link.
footer: Made for your time on court.
prototype: Host login · Player management comes next

auth.loginBody: Sign in to manage your court.
auth.existingOnly: Use the host account already provisioned for CourtHost. There is no public registration.
auth.invalidForm: Enter a valid email and your password.
auth.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your account email before signing in.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.requestFailed: Could not sign in. Check your connection and project configuration, then try again.
auth.configBody: Check VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in .env.local. Use an HTTPS project URL and a publishable key beginning sb_publishable_. Restart pnpm dev after saving.
auth.sessionFailed: Could not restore your sign-in. Check your connection and retry.
auth.profileFailed: Your sign-in exists, but we could not read your host profile. Check your connection and project settings, then retry.
auth.deniedBody: This account has no authorized host profile. Sign out and use the host account you provisioned.
auth.successBody: You are signed in and your host profile was read successfully.
auth.nextBody: Player and session management screens are coming in the next development step. No session data is displayed here yet.
auth.logoutFailed: Sign-out failed. Check your connection and try again.

players.title: Total Players
players.subtitle: Manage your tennis roster.
players.loadError: Could not load players. Check your connection and try again.
players.empty: Your roster is empty. Add your first player.
players.addHelp: Build your roster in one go. Add a name and skill level for each player.
players.archiveBody: Archive {{name}} from the active roster? Existing session participation and history stay unchanged.
players.deleteBody: Permanently delete {{name}}? This cannot be undone. Players referenced by a session cannot be deleted.
players.name: Player name
players.nameError: Enter a name between 1 and 100 characters.
players.skillError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.
players.snapshotNote: Name and skill changes apply to future session entries. Existing session snapshots stay unchanged.
players.permissionError: Host access is required. Sign in again with your host account.
players.referencedError: This player belongs to a session and cannot be deleted. Keep the player archived to preserve history.
players.notFoundError: This player no longer exists. Close this window and refresh the list.
players.validationError: Check the name and skill rating, then try again.
players.saveError: Could not confirm the change. Check your connection, close this window and refresh before trying again.
